segments.name: Mobile Virtual Network Operators (MVNO)
segments.description: Provides subsidized (Lifeline) and non-subsidized prepaid mobile broadband and phone services to underserved consumers nationwide.
segments.evidence: Our Mobile Virtual Network Operators consisting of SurgePhone Wireless and Torch Wireless provide mobile broadband (internet connectivity) to consumers nationwide.

segments.name: Point-of-Sale and Prepaid Services (Top-up)
products: ACH banking and fintech transactions platform
segments.description: Provides point-of-sale transaction processing, prepaid wireless top-ups, and fintech transaction services for independently owned convenience stores.
segments.evidence: The Point-of-Sale and Prepaid Services segment is comprised of Surge Fintech and ECS as previously shown.

revenueModel.text: Consumers and retail partners pay for wireless services, prepaid top-ups, and transaction processing, with revenue from recurring wireless services, transaction fees, and value-added services.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue is generated through recurring wireless services, transaction fees, and other value-added services delivered through the Company's platform.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company abandoned its lead generation segment operations after a strategic reassessment.
changes.evidence: Effective December 31, 2024, the Company's management elected to abandon its lead generation segment operations as part of a strategic reassessment of its business lines.

changes.text: In 2024, the Affordable Connectivity Program ended and the Company transitioned subscribers to the Lifeline program.
changes.evidence: The Company previously participated in the Affordable Connectivity Program, which ended in 2024.
